title: game/procedures/<id>.json
description: One procedure (W05, design 10.7): a short job done at a station, step by step, with the items it makes and uses, the chunks it is grouped in and its goal. Every step and chunk and the goal name a does row of the phrase sheet (content/PHRASES.md), whose line the NPC says. Every name of an item is an item of game/nouns.json (the item kinds); every noun of a step is a catalogue noun. Loaded by ProcedureBook (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

id.description: The procedure's id: its file's name (bread).

station.description: The station it is done at (game/stations.json).

teacher.description: The NPC who teaches it (game/npcs.json); the lines of its does rows are that NPC's.

level.description: The level the procedure's Spanish keeps to (the CEFR lists up to it).

bonus.description: One more of the item when at least firstTimeSteps steps were right the first time.

leaves.description: The item the container is left as when it is used up (water-bottle leaves bottle).

row.description: The does row the chunk's instruction is (haz-la-masa).

steps.description: The step ids, contiguous, in order.

row.description: The does row of the whole procedure (haz-pan).
The does row the step's instruction is (pon-la-harina).

do.description: The verb lemma the learner says (poner).

what.description: The noun acted on: a held item (flour) or a fixture (bowl); the id of a catalogue noun of game/nouns.json.

use.description: The noun the learner acts with, when it is not what (hand for sacar); the id of a catalogue noun. Default: what, for where and from; with, for with.

where.description: The fixture the thing goes to (bowl, oven): the id of a catalogue noun.

from.description: The fixture the thing comes from (oven).

with.description: The fixture or tool the act is done with (spoon).

anyOrder.description: The group the step belongs to: steps with the same group may come in either order (the runner draws it per bake). Design 10.7 gives it the group's fixture.
